description: Seed opening inventory: a lot that predates Splits custody. Requires unit price, acquisition time, and quantity together. A seed alone creates no lot: the lot appears once 'assertions designate' marks an inbound transfer as drawing from it. Quantity is in base units (wei for ETH, 6-decimal units for USDC).

acquisitionTime.description: When the lot was acquired. ISO 8601, must be in the past.

smartAccountId.description: Account id the lot belongs to (from 'accounts list')

targetKey.description: Caller-chosen key naming the seeded lot. Reuse it to correct that lot; pick a new one for a new lot. Rerunning with the same key updates the lot instead of creating a second one.

unitPrice.description: Cost basis per whole token, in USD

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_assertions_seed
